preconditions.description: Dimensions n, m, k are integers between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(lines) == n * m + (n - 1) and all(len(line) == k or line == '' for line in lines)
preconditions.description: Input contains n blocks of m lines each with k characters, separated by exactly one empty line between blocks.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for line in lines if line for c in line)
preconditions.description: All non-empty lines contain only '0' or '1' characters representing CPU states.

postconditions.expression: output == str(sum(1 for x in range(n) for y in range(m) for z in range(k) if grid[x][y][z] == '1' and is_critical(x, y, z, grid, n, m, k)))
postconditions.description: Output is the count of critical CPUs, where a working CPU is critical if removing it breaks at least one existing control path between two other distinct working CPUs.

postconditions.expression: all((x, y, z) in [(x, y, z) for x in range(n) for y in range(m) for z in range(k) if grid[x][y][z] == '1'] for x, y, z in critical_cpus)
postconditions.description: Only currently working CPUs (state '1') can be critical; broken CPUs are never counted.

postconditions.expression: all(not exists_path(a, b, c, d, e, f, grid, n, m, k, exclude=(x, y, z)) for (x, y, z) in critical_cpus for (a, b, c), (d, e, f) in pairs_controlled_by(x, y, z, grid, n, m, k))
postconditions.description: For each critical CPU, there exists at least one pair of distinct working CPUs (source, target) such that a control path exists before removal but no path exists after removal.
